## Description

Text-only packed Qwen microbatches can carry modality token types without visual grids or deepstack embeddings. Keep both pre-pack and CP-local visual masks absent in this case, while preserving masks for real images and videos. This prevents text-only requests from failing during deepstack/CP/SP processing.

Native SGLang image resizing can diverge from the image inputs reconstructed for Megatron training. Align both paths with the native resize and processor rules, preserve visual text token types, and compact multimodal tensors before transport. When selected on the SGLang server, the AReaL processor integration and CPU image decoding fix can be installed without a separately patched SGLang distribution.

For supported Qwen VLMs, `AREAL_VLM_ALIGN_SGLANG` defaults to `true`: the OpenAI proxy follows SGLang image preprocessing for training inputs while forwarding the original image bytes. `SGLANG_VLM_QWEN_LIMIT_PIXEL` independently defaults to `true` and reduces the eligible maximum pixel budget by 16; set it to `false` for the full budget, with the same value in the SGLang server and proxy environments. Set `AREAL_VLM_ALIGN_SGLANG=false` only to use the proxy's original HF preprocessing; it does not change SGLang. Separately, `SGLANG_EXTERNAL_MM_PROCESSOR_PACKAGE=areal.engine.sglang_processors` opts the SGLang server into the validated AReaL processor and CPU/PIL path. Without this server opt-in, startup leaves SGLang's Qwen3-VL/Qwen3.5 sources and any third-party processor unchanged. The docs describe the validated SGLang runtime and how to prepatch a read-only image.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Keep generated visual special tokens in the text domain of native Bridge."""
+
+import inspect
+from functools import wraps
+from types import FunctionType, MethodType
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+
+def visual_lookup_ids(
+    input_ids: torch.Tensor, token_types: torch.Tensor, model: Any
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Build IDs used only by visual scatter and mRoPE, never by embeddings."""
+    if input_ids.shape != token_types.shape:
+        raise ValueError("Visual token types must match native Bridge input_ids")
+    token_types = token_types.to(device=input_ids.device)
+    visual = (input_ids == model.image_token_id) | (input_ids == model.video_token_id)
+    # Vision-start markers themselves have type zero in HF processors. Keep a
+    # marker only if its following token belongs to an actual image/video span.
+    start = input_ids == model.vision_start_token_id
+    actual_start = torch.zeros_like(start)
+    actual_start[..., :-1] = token_types[..., 1:] != 0
+    return input_ids.masked_fill(
+        (visual & (token_types == 0)) | (start & ~actual_start), -1
+    )
+
+
+def install_qwen3_vl_token_mask(
+    models: list[torch.nn.Module],
+) -> list[torch.nn.Module]:
+    """Bridge pre-wrap hook for Qwen3-VL and Qwen3.5's native VLM forward.
+
+    The pinned forward ignores mm_token_type_ids. Bind its visual utilities to
+    this invocation, without changing dependency globals or token embeddings.
+    The native forward still owns vision execution, packing, CP and deepstack.
+    """
+    for model in models:
+        if getattr(model, "_areal_qwen3_vl_token_mask", False):
+            continue
+        original = model.forward.__func__
+        namespace = original.__globals__
+        required = ("reorganize_inputs", "get_rope_index", "preprocess_packed_seqs")
+        if not all(callable(namespace.get(name)) for name in required):
+            raise ValueError("Unsupported native Qwen-VL forward utility contract")
+        signature = inspect.signature(original)
+        reorganize = namespace["reorganize_inputs"]
+        rope = namespace["get_rope_index"]
+        pack = namespace["preprocess_packed_seqs"]
+        rope_signature = inspect.signature(rope)
+
+        # Capture each model's implementation independently (virtual PP chunks
+        # may call different forwards). No module-global monkey patches.
+        def make_forward(
+            original, namespace, signature, reorganize, rope, pack, rope_signature
+        ):
+            @wraps(original)
+            def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+                arguments = signature.bind(self, *args, **kwargs)
+                arguments.apply_defaults()
+                values = arguments.arguments
+                input_ids = values["input_ids"]
+                types = values.get("mm_token_type_ids")
+                if types is None:
+                    if any(
+                        values.get(key) is not None
+                        for key in ("pixel_values", "pixel_values_videos")
+                    ):
+                        raise ValueError(
+                            "Native Qwen-VL vision requires mm_token_type_ids"
+                        )
+                    return original(self, *args, **kwargs)
+                lookup_ids = visual_lookup_ids(input_ids, types, self)
+                packed_types = None
+                has_visual_grid = False
+
+                def typed_reorganize(*call_args, **call_kwargs):
+                    nonlocal packed_types, has_visual_grid
+                    ids = call_kwargs.get(
+                        "input_ids", call_args[0] if call_args else None
+                    )
+                    if ids is input_ids:
+                        vision_data, vision_grid, vision_mask = reorganize(
+                            **{
+                                **call_kwargs,
+                                "input_ids": lookup_ids,
+                                "image_input_mask": lookup_ids == self.image_token_id,
+                                "video_input_mask": lookup_ids == self.video_token_id,
+                            }
+                        )
+                        # Bridge creates deepstack features only for a nonempty
+                        # grid. Keep its visual mask absent in the same case.
+                        has_visual_grid = (
+                            vision_grid is not None and vision_grid.shape[0] > 0
+                        )
+                        return (
+                            vision_data,
+                            vision_grid,
+                            vision_mask if has_visual_grid else None,
+                        )
+                    # The native forward's second call only consumes the mask
+                    # after packing/CP. Reorganizing full image grids using a
+                    # CP-local ID subset would also break mixed image/video.
+                    if values.get("packed_seq_params") is None:
+                        raise ValueError("Unexpected native Qwen-VL visual ID layout")
+                    if not has_visual_grid:
+                        return None, None, None
+                    if packed_types is None:
+                        mask = values.get("attention_mask")
+                        if mask is None:
+                            mask = torch.ones_like(input_ids, dtype=torch.bool)
+                        packed_types = pack(
+                            types,
+                            mask,
+                            pre_process=True,
+                            pg_collection=self.pg_collection,
+                        )[0]
+                    if packed_types.shape != ids.shape:
+                        raise ValueError(
+                            "Packed visual token types must match CP-local IDs"
+                        )
+                    visual_mask = (
+                        (ids == self.image_token_id) | (ids == self.video_token_id)
+                    ) & (packed_types != 0)
+                    return None, None, visual_mask
+
+                def typed_rope(*call_args, **call_kwargs):
+                    bound = rope_signature.bind(*call_args, **call_kwargs)
+                    bound.arguments["input_ids"] = lookup_ids
+                    return rope(*bound.args, **bound.kwargs)
+
+                scoped = FunctionType(
+                    original.__code__,
+                    {
+                        **namespace,
+                        "reorganize_inputs": typed_reorganize,
+                        "get_rope_index": typed_rope,
+                    },
+                    original.__name__,
+                    original.__defaults__,
+                    original.__closure__,
+                )
+                scoped.__kwdefaults__ = original.__kwdefaults__
+                return scoped(self, *args, **kwargs)
+
+            return forward
+
+        model.forward = MethodType(
+            make_forward(
+                original, namespace, signature, reorganize, rope, pack, rope_signature
+            ),
+            model,
+        )
+        model._areal_qwen3_vl_token_mask = True
+    return models

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Avoid serializing a whole image batch for each split CPU tensor view."""
+
+from dataclasses import replace
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+
+def _compact_cpu_storage(value: Any, memo: dict[int, Any]) -> Any:
+    identity = id(value)
+    if identity in memo:
+        return memo[identity]
+    if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
+        result = value
+        if (
+            value.device.type == "cpu"
+            and value.layout == torch.strided
+            and value.untyped_storage().nbytes() > value.numel() * value.element_size()
+        ):
+            result = value.clone()
+    elif isinstance(value, dict):
+        result = {key: _compact_cpu_storage(item, memo) for key, item in value.items()}
+    elif isinstance(value, list):
+        result = [_compact_cpu_storage(item, memo) for item in value]
+    elif isinstance(value, tuple):
+        result = tuple(_compact_cpu_storage(item, memo) for item in value)
+    else:
+        result = value
+    memo[identity] = result
+    return result
+
+
+def compact_mm_item_storage(items: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
+    """Copy per-request metadata and compact CPU views without mutating cached items.
+
+    Native preprocessing splits a batch into per-image views. Pickle serializes
+    each view's entire backing storage, so N images can transmit N copies of the
+    batch. Compact only those CPU views; retain tensor values, hashes, pad IDs,
+    already compact tensors, and native CUDA/IPC objects.
+    """
+    memo: dict[int, Any] = {}
+    return [
+        replace(
+            item,
+            feature=_compact_cpu_storage(item.feature, memo),
+            precomputed_embeddings=_compact_cpu_storage(
+                item.precomputed_embeddings, memo
+            ),
+            model_specific_data=_compact_cpu_storage(item.model_specific_data, memo),
+        )
+        for item in items
+    ]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Keep literal visual special tokens in chat text out of HF image expansion."""
+
+from copy import copy, deepcopy
+from typing import Any
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from areal.utils.hf_utils import apply_chat_template
+
+_VISUAL_TOKENS = (
+    "<|image_pad|>",
+    "<|video_pad|>",
+    "<|vision_start|>",
+    "<|vision_end|>",
+)
+
+
+def protect_vision_tokens(
+    processor: Any,
+    tokenizer: Any,
+    messages: list[dict],
+    tools: Any,
+    template_kwargs: dict,
+    prompt_text: str,
+) -> tuple[Any, str, dict[int, int]]:
+    """Escape request text using single tokens on a request-local tokenizer.
+
+    Actual typed image parts are rendered by the template as usual. Restoring
+    the temporary IDs after processing preserves token boundaries, including
+    when literal visual tokens touch ordinary text. Shared tokenizer/processor
+    objects and the canonical history are never mutated.
+    """
+
+    def strings(value):
+        if isinstance(value, str):
+            yield value
+        elif isinstance(value, dict):
+            for key, item in value.items():
+                yield from strings(key)
+                yield from strings(item)
+        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+            for item in value:
+                yield from strings(item)
+
+    # The template source contains genuine image placeholders and is code,
+    # whereas its other arguments are request data rendered into that code.
+    text_kwargs = {
+        key: value for key, value in template_kwargs.items() if key != "chat_template"
+    }
+    values = (messages, tools, text_kwargs)
+    text_values = list(strings(values))
+    text_tokenizer = getattr(processor, "tokenizer", None)
+    decoder = getattr(text_tokenizer, "added_tokens_decoder", {})
+    dangerous = [
+        token
+        for token in _VISUAL_TOKENS
+        if text_tokenizer is not None
+        and any(token in s for s in text_values)
+        and str(decoder.get(text_tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(token))) == token
+    ]
+    if not dangerous:
+        return processor, prompt_text, {}
+
+    from transformers import AddedToken
+
+    local_tokenizer = deepcopy(processor.tokenizer)
+    replacements = {}
+    restore_ids = {}
+    for token in dangerous:
+        original_id = local_tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(token)
+        original = local_tokenizer.added_tokens_decoder.get(original_id)
+        if original is None or str(original) != token:
+            raise ValueError(f"Cannot preserve unregistered visual token {token!r}")
+        marker = f"<|areal_text_{uuid4().hex}|>"
+        while marker in prompt_text or any(marker in s for s in text_values):
+            marker = f"<|areal_text_{uuid4().hex}|>"
+        local_tokenizer.add_tokens(
+            [
+                AddedToken(
+                    marker,
+                    **{
+                        key: getattr(original, key)
+                        for key in (
+                            "single_word",
+                            "lstrip",
+                            "rstrip",
+                            "normalized",
+                            "special",
+                        )
+                    },
+                )
+            ],
+            special_tokens=True,
+        )
+        marker_ids = local_tokenizer.encode(marker, add_special_tokens=False)
+        if len(marker_ids) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("Visual text escape must encode to exactly one token")
+        replacements[token] = marker
+        restore_ids[marker_ids[0]] = original_id
+
+    def escape(value):
+        if isinstance(value, str):
+            for token, marker in replacements.items():
+                value = value.replace(token, marker)
+            return value
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            return {escape(key): escape(item) for key, item in value.items()}
+        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+            return [escape(item) for item in value]
+        return value
+
+    protected = apply_chat_template(
+        tokenizer,
+        escape(messages),
+        tools=escape(tools),
+        add_generation_prompt=True,
+        tokenize=False,
+        **{
+            **escape(text_kwargs),
+            **(
+                {"chat_template": template_kwargs["chat_template"]}
+                if "chat_template" in template_kwargs
+                else {}
+            ),
+        },
+    )
+    restored = protected
+    for token, marker in replacements.items():
+        restored = restored.replace(marker, token)
+    if restored != prompt_text:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Chat template changes structure when escaping visual text tokens"
+        )
+    local_processor = copy(processor)
+    local_processor.tokenizer = local_tokenizer
+    return local_processor, protected, restore_ids

+``AREAL_VLM_ALIGN_SGLANG`` defaults to true. Set it to false to use the

+

+import os
+from functools import lru_cache
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, NamedTuple

+
+def sglang_image_alignment_enabled() -> bool:
+    """Read the AReaL image-alignment switch without changing server settings."""
+    value = os.environ.get("AREAL_VLM_ALIGN_SGLANG", "true").strip().lower()
+    if value not in ("true", "false", "1", "0", "yes", "no", "y", "n"):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Invalid AREAL_VLM_ALIGN_SGLANG boolean value; use true or false"
+        )
+    return value in ("true", "1", "yes", "y")
+

+def _processor_model_type(model_name_or_path: str) -> str | None:

+    config, _ = PretrainedConfig.get_config_dict(model_name_or_path)

+def _sglang_image_size(
+    height: int, width: int, factor: int, min_pixels: int, max_pixels: int
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Match QwenVLImageProcessor.smart_resize_for_image in SGLang 0.5.18."""
+    if min(height, width) <= 0 or max(height, width) / min(height, width) > 200:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Qwen-VL images must have positive dimensions and aspect ratio <= 200"
+        )
+    h = max(factor, round(height / factor) * factor)
+    w = max(factor, round(width / factor) * factor)
+    if h * w > max_pixels:
+        scale = math.sqrt(height * width / max_pixels)
+        h = math.floor(height / scale / factor) * factor
+        w = math.floor(width / scale / factor) * factor
+    elif h * w < min_pixels:
+        scale = math.sqrt(min_pixels / (height * width))
+        h = math.ceil(height * scale / factor) * factor
+        w = math.ceil(width * scale / factor) * factor

+        )

+    min_pixels: int

+        return None

+        return None

+        },

+def image_prompt_metadata(

+    input_ids: list[int],
+    token_types: list[int] | None,
+    image_data: list[str] | None,

+    result = dict(metadata or {})
+    image_id = getattr(processor, "image_token_id", None)
+    if not image_data or not isinstance(image_id, int) or token_types is None:
+        return result

+        if token != image_id or modality != 1:
+            continue

+            spans[-1][1] = index

+        raise ValueError("Real image spans do not match the supplied images")

+    ambiguous case sends original IDs and real spans to AReaL's external Qwen
+    processor, avoiding decode/retokenize and preserving sampled boundaries.

+            req.image_data
+            and tokenizer is not None
+            and tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|image_pad|>") == image_id
+            and compacted.count(image_id) != len(req.image_data)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Ambiguous Qwen image tokens require explicit real-image spans; "
+                "cannot infer images from sampled token IDs"
+            )
+        return {"input_ids": compacted}
+    image_id = getattr(req.processor, "image_token_id", None)
+    validate_image_spans(tokens, spans, image_id, len(req.image_data))
+    tokenizer = req.processor.tokenizer
+    vision_start = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|vision_start|>")
+    vision_end = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids("<|vision_end|>")
+    allowed = set()
+    for start, end in spans:
+        allowed.update(range(start, end + 1))
+        if start > 0 and tokens[start - 1] == vision_start:
+            allowed.add(start - 1)

+            allowed.add(end + 1)

+        for token in (
+            "<|image_pad|>",
+            "<|video_pad|>",
+            "<|vision_start|>",
+            "<|vision_end|>",
+        )
+    }

+        for index, token in enumerate(tokens)
+    ):

+            "input_ids": tokens,
+            "mm_sampling_kwargs": {IMAGE_SPANS_KEY: spans},
+        }

+
+def validate_image_spans(
+    tokens: list[int], spans: list[list[int]], image_id: int, image_count: int
+) -> None:
+    """Reject stale/ambiguous metadata before assigning any image features."""
+    if not isinstance(spans, list) or len(spans) != image_count:
+        raise ValueError("Real image spans must match image count")
+    previous_end = -1
+    for span in spans:

+        cursor = 0

+            cursor = end + 1

+        return compact_ids

+    image_count = 0
+    previous_is_image = False

+        is_image = token == image_token_id
+        if is_image and previous_is_image:
+            continue
+        if is_image:

+        compact_ids.append(token)
+        previous_is_image = is_image
+
+    if image_count != len(req.image_data):
+        return req.input_ids.copy()
+    return compact_ids
